t: Look up at Manhattan Loft Gardens, a 42-storey apartment tower in Stratford. It stands 143 metres, or 469 feet, tall. The architects and structural engineers were Skidmore, Owings and Merrill. It was commissioned by Harry Handelsman, founder and chief executive of Manhattan Loft Corporation, a London property development company. That is the connection to the place: it was his company's project, and the tower now stands over this part of east London.
